en.title: The comic version of "The Wizard's Night" begins serialization in the 50th issue of "Weekly Shonen Magazine" published today. The manga is written by Keigo Maki.
en.summary: The serialization of the comic version of ``The Night of the Wizard'' began in the 50th issue of Kodansha's manga magazine ``Weekly Shonen Magazine'' published today (November 11, 2026). The manga will be written by Keigo Maki, who is known for ``The Shikimori-san who is not just cute.'' The original ``The Night of the Wizard'' is a visual novel for PC developed by TYPE-MOON and released in 2012.

zh.title: 玩《铁拳 8》前，袋鼠“Roger Jr.”与父母和孩子打架。看看充分利用 3 种姿势和强大的投掷技术的进化战斗风格
zh.summary: 我们为大家带来了追加角色“小罗杰”的初步游玩报告。他将于 2026 年 11 月 17 日加入 Bandai Namco Entertainment 的 3D 格斗游戏《铁拳 8》（抢先体验将于 11 月 12 日开始）。袋鼠作为军事动物而诞生，时隔十多年再次回归该系列。

The kangaroo, which was created as a military animal, returns to the series after more than 10 years.

en.title: 2D action adventure “Nekomata Traveling with Ruins Island” will be released on Steam on January 19, 2027. Also decided to port to Switch
en.summary: TamagawaSoft announced on November 10, 2026 that ``Nekomata Traveling with Ruins Island'' will be released on Steam on January 19, 2027. The price is 2250 yen (tax included). This is a 2D action-adventure game in which you control Kijino, a cat with two tails, as he explores ruins hidden in the forest.

items.title: 「Arkheron」はフレンドパス対応で1人買えば3人遊べる。価格やサポーターエディションなどの情報が公開に
items.summary: BonfireStudiosは本日（2026年11月10日），日本時間の11月28日に早期アクセスの開始を予定している新作タイトル「Arkheron」の最新情報を発表した。リリースから3日間は誰でも無料でプレイできるほか，1人買えば3人遊べる“フレンドパス”の内容も明かされた。

zh.title: 《Arkhron》支持好友通行证，所以如果你买一张，三个人就可以玩。价格、支持版本等信息已经发布。
zh.summary: BonfireStudios 今天（2026 年 11 月 10 日）公布了新作《Arkheron》的最新信息，该作预计于日本时间 11 月 28 日开始抢先体验。发售后任何人都可以免费玩三天，并且还公开了“Friend Pass”的详细信息，即一个人购买就可以让三个人玩。

en.title: ``Arkheron'' supports friend passes, so if you buy one, three people can play. Information such as price and supporter edition has been released.
en.summary: BonfireStudios today (November 10, 2026) announced the latest information on the new title "Arkheron", which is scheduled to start early access on November 28, Japan time. Anyone can play for free for three days after release, and the details of the ``Friend Pass'', which allows three people to play if one person buys, were also revealed.

items.title: KRAFTON，2026年第3四半期の業績を発表。「PUBG」10周年記念アップデートの計画や新作「PUBG: DED.NET」の開発状況を公開
items.summary: KRAFTONは本日，2026年第3四半期の業績を発表した。2027年に「PUBG」シリーズ10周年を記念した過去最大規模のアップデートを計画しているほか，「サブノーティカ2」の年末の大型アップデートや，新作シューター「PUBG:DED.NET」の開発状況なども明らかになっている。

zh.title: KRAFTON公布2026年第三季度财务业绩《PUBG》十周年更新计划及新作《PUBG：DED.NET》开发状况揭晓
zh.summary: KRAFTON 今天公布了 2026 年第三季度的财务业绩。除了计划在 2027 年进行有史以来最大规模的更新来纪念《PUBG》系列十周年外，还透露将有《深海迷航 2》的年末重大更新以及新射击游戏《PUBG:DED.NET》的开发状况。

en.title: KRAFTON announces financial results for the third quarter of 2026. "PUBG" 10th anniversary update plan and development status of new "PUBG: DED.NET" revealed
en.summary: KRAFTON today announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026. In addition to planning the largest update ever to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the ``PUBG'' series in 2027, it has also been revealed that there will be a major year-end update for ``Subnautica 2'' and the development status of the new shooter ``PUBG:DED.NET''.

en.summary: Square Enix today (November 10, 2026) released the outline of the smartphone app ``Dragon Quest RPG Makai Tree and the Guided Island''. This work is an RPG adventure experience of ``exploring, fighting with commands, and raising children'' of the ``Dragon Quest'' series, designed for smartphones. It has also been decided to hold a closed beta test.

items.summary: CRITICALREFLEXは本日，オープンワールドADV「TANUKI:Pon'sSummer-タヌキ：ポンの夏」を発売した。郵便配達員のタヌキ「ポン」となり，BMXで日本の島を駆け巡りながら配達や住民との交流を楽しむ作品だ。100種類以上のBMXチャレンジや多彩なアクティビティも用意され，その報酬で神社の再建を目指す。

zh.title: 骑着小轮车绕岛一周并递送邮件。 《TANUKI：Pon 的夏天》今天上映。享受超过 100 个 BMX 挑战

en.title: Ride around the island on a BMX and deliver the mail. "TANUKI: Pon's Summer", released today. Enjoy over 100 BMX challenges
en.summary: CRITICALREFLEX today released the open world ADV "TANUKI: Pon's Summer". In this work, you take on the role of Pon, a raccoon dog who is a postman, and rides around a Japanese island on a BMX, enjoying deliveries and interacting with residents. There are over 100 types of BMX challenges and various activities, and the aim is to rebuild the shrine with the rewards.

I am very happy about the restoration of the column name. On the one hand, I think the word "night talk" sounds better, very classical and leisurely, and it naturally reminds people of the context of "Lengzhai Night Talk" where friends meet each other. On the other hand, I am also afraid of the word "weird talk". Most of the time, I feel that what I write is very ordinary, and does not have the momentum of deliberately being weird. Friendships Between Old and New In the past, when I met colleagues and friends on business trips, or chatted with new colleagues who were about to join the company, someone would always tell me that he liked it very much and wanted to try writing the "Touching Night Talk" column. ja.title: BioWare 共同創設者: Mass Effect 5 の保存には 2 億ドルかかる
ja.summary: BioWare の共同創設者であるトレント・オースター氏は、マスエフェクト 5 の新作を作るには 2 億ドル以上かかると述べました。同氏は、プレイヤーは一流の AAA 開発品質を期待しており、そのためには非常に高額な先行投資が必要になると考えています。トレント・オースターの声明は、最近の「マスエフェクトを救え」オンライン請願の結果として出された。請願者らはEAに対し、マスエフェクトシリーズへの資金提供を継続するか、他のスタジオに権利を販売しライセンス供与するよう求めた。このキャンペーンはこれまでにChange.orgで30万以上の署名を集めている。 EAは以前、RPGスタジオBioWareを閉鎖し、『Mass Effect 5』の開発を中止させた。 「ドラゴンエイジ」の元プロデューサーであるマーク・ダラー氏などの開発者も、EAが権利を売却し、プロジェクトを他のチームの手に委ねることを提案した。しかし、業界では、権利を購入し、数億ドルの開発予算を負担できるスタジオはほんの一握りであると考えられています。

en.title: BioWare co-founder: Saving Mass Effect 5 will cost $200 million
en.summary: BioWare co-founder Trent Auster said it would cost more than $200 million to make a new Mass Effect 5 game. He believes that players expect top-notch AAA development quality, which requires extremely high upfront capital investment. Trent Auster's statement comes as a result of the recent "Save Mass Effect" online petition. The petitioners called on EA to continue funding the Mass Effect series, or to sell and license the rights to other studios. The campaign has so far collected more than 300,000 signatures on Change.org. EA previously closed RPG studio BioWare, causing the development of "Mass Effect 5" to be canceled. Developers such as Mark Darrah, the former producer of "Dragon Age", also suggested that EA sell the rights and let the project continue in the hands of other teams. However, the industry believes that there are only a handful of studios that can afford to buy the rights and shoulder a development budget of hundreds of millions of dollars.

ja.title: 第二次世界大戦リアルタイム戦術ゲーム「Steel Platoon」正式発表
ja.summary: Tactical Moveが制作したSteel Platoonが正式発表。このゲームは 1941 年のモスクワ防衛戦争に基づいており、リアルタイム戦術ゲームのゲームプレイに RPG 要素が組み込まれていると報告されています。プレイヤーは赤軍中尉となり、軍隊を率いてカルーガ近郊の絶望的な状況から戦い撤退し、街が解放されるまで最も困難な瞬間を生き抜きます。キャンペーン マップには 15 のミッションが交互に配置されています。次にどこで戦うか、どのルートを取るか、追加の目標を達成するためにリスクを冒すかどうかを決めるのはプレイヤー次第です。あらゆる戦闘、あらゆる選択、あらゆる戦場への復帰がその後の戦況に影響を与え、物語をさまざまな結末へと導きます。プレイヤーはゲーム内で歩兵、戦車、砲兵、支援部隊を指揮し、複数の兵器が連携した激しい作戦に従事します。地形、バンカー、煙幕を利用して秘密作戦を実行したり、側面を突いてフェイントでおびき寄せて敵の裏をかいたり、優れた火力を集めて正面から攻撃したりできます。

en.title: World War II real-time tactics game "Steel Platoon" officially announced
en.summary: Steel Platoon, created by Tactical Move, is officially announced. It is reported that this game is based on the 1941 Moscow Defense War and incorporates RPG elements into the gameplay of a real-time tactical game. The player will play a Red Army lieutenant, leading the troops to fight and retreat from the desperate situation near Kaluga, surviving the most difficult moments until the city is liberated. 15 missions are staggered on the campaign map. It is up to the player to decide where to fight next, which route to take, and whether to take risks to complete additional objectives. Every battle, every choice, every return to the battlefield will affect the subsequent battle situation and lead the story to different endings. Players will command infantry, tanks, artillery and support units in the game and engage in intense multi-arms coordinated operations. Use terrain, bunkers and smoke screens to carry out covert operations, outflank and lure the enemy with feints to outwit the opponent, or gather superior firepower to strike head-on.
